disagreements.a1_note: E2 (2024) identifies the installation as the Bintan 4.0 MWp ground-mounted solar system due 2H 2025; no 2025 evidence reports its completion; E6 and E9 speak of solar capacity expansion and renewable energy investments without naming it; the promise sentence lacks the antecedent of 'the installation'
disagreements.a2_note: E6; E9: the 2025 report speaks of expanding solar capacity and overseeing renewable energy investments but never reports completion of the installation; the promise names no installation, E2 (2024) identifies it as a 4.0 MWp Bintan ground-mounted system due 2H 2025; E1's initiative completed in 2024 cannot be attributed to it

disagreements.a1_note: E5; E8: absolute water consumption rose from 138,267.5 to 152,552.4 Cu M in FY2022 while the consumption rate held at 0.8 per S$'000 revenue, and the company's own performance cell answers in intensity terms ('No material changes in water consumption intensity') though the target is worded 'water consumption'; the extraction does not say whether the target is absolute or intensity, so neither the rise nor the flat rate can be read as this target's verdict.
disagreements.a2_note: E5; E8: absolute water consumption rose from 138,267.5 to 152,552.4 m3 in FY2022 while the consumption rate stayed at 0.8 m3 per S$'000; the company's own performance column answers the 'maintain or reduce water consumption' target with 'no material changes in water consumption intensity' and the FY2023 target is reworded to intensity. The extraction omits the rate/intensity qualifier the evidence attaches, so absolute (failed) versus intensity (achieved) cannot be settled.

disagreements.a1_note: E1: the FY2024 report points to pp.9-12 for 'commitments and strategies' on the key focus areas, which may be the calibrated targets and roadmap, but the evidence shown never names them; E2-E11 are page headers with no content.
disagreements.a2_note: E1: the FY2024 report points to pages 9-12 for its commitments and strategies on key focus areas, which touches the subject, but no retrieved passage shows the calibrated targets or the sustainability roadmap developed with the Sponsor being presented; E2-E11 are page footers with no content.

disagreements.a1_note: E3-E6: FY2023 evidence shows the phase-out roadmap in operation (no CFC refrigerants sold, a phased plan to meet local phase-out requirements, R448/R449A and natural gases usable in equipment as at end FY2023); E7 shows the roadmap is HCFC phase-out by 2030 under the Montreal Protocol, a qualifier the extraction omits.
disagreements.a2_note: E2; E4; E6: a maintain-the-roadmap commitment is a practice; the FY2023 evidence shows it in operation (working towards NEA phase-out targets, a phased plan in place, CFC refrigerants not sold, R448/R449A and natural gases usable in equipment by end FY2023). E7 restates the roadmap as HCFC phase-out by 2030 under the Montreal Protocol, which is the roadmap's own horizon rather than a postponement of this commitment.

disagreements.a1_note: E3; E7; E5; E11-E12: a qualitative scenario analysis was conducted (reported 2024 and 2025), but the company still 'remains committed to scenario analysis' and defers the quantitative analysis to coming years. The promise and extraction carry neither qualifier, so I cannot tell whether the qualitative exercise is the promised analysis or a partial step; case worth writing up.
disagreements.a2_note: E3; E7; E4-E5; E12: a qualitative scenario analysis was conducted (2024) and is reported in 2025, but the quantitative scenario analysis the company scheduled for 2025 (E4) is deferred to 'coming years' (E5, E12) and E11 still calls scenario analysis a commitment; the promise does not say which kind, so it cannot be told whether the completed analysis is this deliverable.
